The 19th edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL 2026) is set to commence on March 28 and conclude on May 31, 2026, with ten teams competing in 84 matches across India. The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has released the schedule for the initial phase, running from March 28 to April 12, which includes 20 matches played at various venues. Defending champions Royal Challengers Bengaluru will open the tournament by hosting Sunrisers Hyderabad in Bengaluru. The full schedule for the season is pending the announcement of State Assembly election dates in several states. The player auction, held on December 16, 2025, in Abu Dhabi, saw teams collectively spend ₹215.45 crore on 77 players, with Cameron Green being the most expensive overseas player, bought by Kolkata Knight Riders for ₹25.20 crore.
